definition.population: Non-government properties with rental bonds lodged in the displayed six-month window; not advertised rents or every existing tenancy.
definition.period_convention: Inclusive six-month window, from the first day of a month through the last day of the sixth consecutive month; not a monthly observation.
definition.limitations: Only two explicitly supported publisher NZAD suburbs, qualified by city; site locality IDs are not official geography codes and do not establish TA, SA2 or postal boundaries. Figures are provisional, incomplete or revisable during bond-system migration. Late lodgements and administrative changes can alter results; no rent-trend inference is established. Absent dwelling/bedroom tuples are not_reported, not zero or inferred suppression.
definition.geography_authority: Publisher NZAD suburb qualified by city; site-owned locality identifiers.
definition.active_bonds: Current bonds within the displayed six-month window. The full-page tooltip also requires complete rent, dwelling, bedroom and address information. This is not all lodged bonds, all current tenancies, listings or an established denominator for the rent quantiles.
definition.revision_policy: Updated monthly, omitting the most recent month; late lodgements and administrative changes can revise results. No official publication timestamp or revision identifier is supplied.

Persistent absence means missing 10% or more of possible sessions; severe absence means 50% or more. Severe absence is a subset of persistent absence; do not add the categories. Publisher nonnumeric symbols remain null, never zero.

pharmacies.attribution: NHS Business Services Authority, Pharmacy Openings and Closures, NHSBSA Open Data
pharmacies.note: Pharmacies on NHS England Pharmaceutical Lists providing NHS prescriptions and pharmaceutical services. Stocks are at month end; openings, closures and net changes cover that calendar month. Ownership changes count as a closure and an opening. Backdated amendments and group changes can affect comparisons between releases. Counts are premises, not patients or prescription volumes.

river_level.note: Latest available observation from one selected river-level gauge; not a Scotland-wide average, flood threshold or height above sea level. Publisher quality code is retained; telemetry may be provisional.

road_traffic.source: Transport Scotland; Department for Transport estimates
road_traffic.note: Calendar-year distance travelled on Scottish roads, not the number of vehicles or road length. Table 5.1. Minor-road estimates since 2000 have been revised following benchmarking; totals may differ from sums because of rounding. Motorways include A(M) roads. The total overlaps all three component categories. This reader uses the explicitly named 2025 publication.

company_insolvencies.note: Calendar-month registered company insolvencies, not seasonally adjusted. Five procedure counts sum to the total; do not add the total again. Moratoriums, restructuring plans and administration-to-CVL conversions are separate series and are not added. Counts are administrative events, not individual people, insolvency rates or forecasts. Monthly statistics may be revised. England-and-Wales combined figures are not relabelled as either nation.
